entry.author: Ministry of Health - Manatū Hauora
entry.summary:
Kiri Richards, Associate Deputy Director-General Mental Health Addiction and Suicide Prevention at the Ministry of Health leads this information session for the Mental Health and Wellbeing Strategy consultation. 

This session explains the draft strategy, how the consultation works, and provide an opportunity for you to ask related questions. You will also hear from some of our consultation partners who are working with us on this important mahi.

To find out more about the consultation and how to submit feedback, see the Ministry of Health website - https://www.health.govt.nz/publications/consultation-on-the-mental-health-and-wellbeing-strategy
